reviews.title: The New Standard
reviews.comment:
I got this PSU for a good price after I saw it scored an A rating on the psu tier list. That was good enough for me, but this thing went above and beyond. High quality cables that look nice, along with some combs. Built in fan controller that made cable management a breeze. Of course the main selling point was the edge access, which is now my default when building in a dual chamber case.
Easy must buy for any dual chamber case build, skip otherwise.
reviews.author: Cole

reviews.title: A impressive psu
reviews.comment: This PSU is top notch. It's well built and very quite.  It has power and plenty of it. The cables are nicely done and have ample length.  The USB fan hub is magnetic and offers plenty of options.  I like it my self.  For the money, you can't go wrong with this unit. I highly recommend this one.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: The best PSU I have ever used
reviews.comment: Fantastic PSU (as expected from this excellent manufacturer).  The best part is the design layout which makes connecting so much easier.  Also has an optional fan hub that cleans up the fan wiring mess.  The removable dust screen is also nice.  Highly recommend this PSU.

reviews.author: Wyatt

reviews.title: Real innovation
reviews.comment: If I could give this thing more stars, I would. Talk about taking a swing and adding innovation to something that has been around a while. The Lian LI PSU with the connections and USB hub is awesome. It made building my newest build a lot easier and simpler. The fact that I didn't have to worry about a USB hub or power connector for the fans was great. The thing is quiet and performs well. I run a 9950X3D and a 5090 with no problem. The cherry on top is the hub's ability to disconnect from the PSU and being magnetic.
reviews.author: Ryan
